title: Modular by design

steps.label: Primary board
steps.body: Coordinates the system. Its processor and radios gather information from every other board and communicate over BLE and LoRaWAN.

steps.label: Sensor board
steps.body: Adds environmental and motion awareness, currently covering air quality, temperature, and acceleration.

steps.label: Lock board
steps.body: Controls the locking unit, with motor drivers to actuate it and cam switches to confirm its position.

steps.label: Interaction board
steps.body: Manages buttons, LEDs, and other local controls so people at the access point get clear feedback.

steps.label: Power board
steps.body: Connects to the system's batteries and distributes power across the whole stack.

note: Board configuration varies by application; not every deployment uses every board.
